outcome: Perceived needs and priorities of postpartum women regarding their hospital birth experience
cohort: 43 women at eight weeks after childbirth and 33 women eight months after childbirth
finding: Postpartum women prioritize a supportive relationship with healthcare professionals, a sense of control and safety, partner involvement, and addressing fears related to childbirth complications and interventions.
mod_finding: Fear of instrumental delivery and/or caesarean section was a significant theme identified among postpartum women.
